symptoms: Refractory seizures, severe metabolic acidosis with anion gap, coma

management_steps.details:
Activated Charcoal 50g NGT if presentation < 1 hour. Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6):
- Known ingested amount: 1g Pyridoxine per gram INH ingested (max 5g total, or 70mg/kg in children) IV/PO.
- Unknown ingested amount: 5g Pyridoxine total PO/NGT. Repeat after 10-20 min if seizures persist.
